original.requirement: Update the skill, role/state guidance and helper only as needed to make this   a concrete final step. The planner decides the appropriate implementation and   necessary test-suite additions using the [verification guide](../verification.md).

Mark the root and each completed subtask Done in their canonical backlog   definitions only after the applicable acceptance criteria and required   verification pass. A parent stays incomplete while any required subtask or   criterion remains open. Failed, unsupported, unavailable or incomplete required   checks cannot justify Done.

Preserve permanent keys, canonical definitions, dependencies and original   acceptance criteria. Leave unfinished items open. Do not change allocation   state in the permanent key registry to represent implementation completion.

Retain concise verification evidence and an honest implementation-PR reference   with the status update. Do not invent a PR number or claim a PR exists before   creation. The planner must choose a reference that works with the publication   order; a stable branch/compare reference is acceptable until an actual PR URL   is known. Do not create an early PR solely to obtain a number.

Include the bookkeeping changes in the final independently reviewed candidate.   If source or backlog edits occur after review, invalidate/repeat the affected   checks under the existing exact-commit rules. Publishing an unreviewed status   commit must not bypass the checker or produce duplicate PRs.

A checker rejection or later change that invalidates completion must also   invalidate the corresponding Done claim. Interruption/resume must preserve   unfinished closeout work rather than report successful bookkeeping that never   happened.

One implementation PR carries the root, subtasks and backlog updates. The   harness never merges it automatically. Merging it is sufficient to update the   backlog on `master`, with no subsequent closeout invocation required.

Apply the resulting completion rule to this item in its implementation PR.   Reconcile the stale FOS-000025 status only against its actual merged PR and   retained verification evidence; do not mark other pending backlog work Done.
